### Observed differences

- In the earlier window, five activities — A20, A21, A30, A31 and A32 — each ran in about 199 of 200 cases (roughly once per case); in the later window each appears in only 1–3 of 200 cases. [OCC003, OCC004, OCC009, OCC010, OCC011]
- Conversely, A19, A22, A23, A24 and A25 were almost unobserved earlier (0–3 of 200 cases) and now each runs in roughly 16–25 of 100 cases. Any pair of them appears together in at most about 1 of 100 later cases, and their shares sum to about one occurrence per case, so a later case typically contains exactly one of them. [OCC002, OCC005, OCC006, OCC007, OCC008, REL033, REL059, REL060, REL067, REL074]
- The old five formed one block with no fixed internal order: A20 and A21 co-occurred in about 199 of 200 earlier cases, with A20 first in about 49 of 100 and A21 first in about 50 of 100, and A20 preceded A33 in about 98 of 100 of those cases. In the later window, A15, A16 and A33 run without the old block. [REL015, REL040, REL048]
- A48's routing changed: earlier, about 95 of 100 of its observed outgoing transitions went to one of the old five (each roughly 17–21 of 100); later, about 95 of 100 go to one of the new five (roughly 14–23 of 100 each), based on about 200 outgoing transitions in each window. [DIR012]
- Each new activity leads on to A33: A19 in about 89 of 100, A22 in all observed, A23 in about 92 of 100 and A24 in about 97 of 100 of their outgoing transitions, and A25 precedes A33 in about 23 of 100 later cases; A48 is followed by A33 within two steps in about 94 of 100 later cases containing the pair (earlier only 2 such cases existed). [DIR003, DIR006, DIR007, DIR008, REL081, LAG029]
- Positions shifted accordingly: A33 now occurs earlier (mean relative position about 0.43 versus 0.50) and A48 slightly later (about 0.38 versus 0.33), while the new activities sit around 0.40–0.43, much where the old block used to sit (about 0.41–0.42). [POS004, POS007, POS008, POS009, POS010, POS014, POS015]
- A04 became more frequent (about 10 → 34 of 100 cases), occurs earlier (mean relative position about 0.28 versus 0.49), and its outgoing transitions — previously spread over roughly ten different successors — now lead to A16 in about 85 of 100 observed transitions, with A16 following within one step in about 98 of 100 later cases containing the pair. [OCC001, DIR001, LAG001, POS001]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that the segment between A48 and A33 was restructured: in the earlier window every case executed the five activities A20, A21, A30, A31 and A32 (in varying order) between A48 and A33, whereas in the later window these are no longer executed and a case instead runs exactly one of the alternatives A19, A22, A23, A24 or A25 after A48, leading directly on to A33. Supporting signs: the near-complete participation flip (about 199 of 200 down to 1–3 of 200, and 0–3 up to 32–49 of 200), the rerouting of A48's outgoing transitions toward the new activities with about 200 observations per window, direct edges from each new activity to A33, near-zero co-occurrence among the new activities with shares summing to about one per case, and consistent position shifts. The screening context reinforces this: 158 control-flow items qualified against roughly 1 expected without change, so the ensemble cannot be attributed to random sampling of a stable process. [OCC003, OCC005, DIR012, DIR006, REL059, LAG029, POS014]

The evidence cannot rule out that the two windows draw on different case populations (for example different case types) rather than a modified process, and the old block still appears in a handful of later cases (1–3 of 200); the "exactly one of five" reading is inferred from pairwise co-occurrence and share sums rather than observed for all five activities jointly. [OCC009, OCC010, REL059]

Other differences: A04 became more frequent (about 10 → 34 of 100 cases), occurs earlier in the case, and now leads mostly directly to A16, whereas earlier its outgoing transitions were spread over many activities; A15 and A16 also occur slightly later in the case. These changes may be connected to the same restructuring, but the evidence does not tie them directly to the A48–A33 segment. [OCC001, DIR001, DIR002, LAG001, POS001, POS002, POS003]
